observations: Single photo shows an electronic keyboard lying on a table, taken from above at an angle.
Keys are visibly yellowed/aged, suggesting significant age or sun exposure.
Model text 'PSR-550' is visible engraved on the body, lower left of the control panel.
No visible brand logo (e.g., Yamaha) readable in this photo.
Control panel has buttons, a data wheel, and a small LCD screen; screen appears to show some faint characters but is not clearly lit or readable.
Speaker grille area (bottom right) is heavily stained/dirty, with dark discoloration.
No power adapter, cable, or power source visible in the photo.
No shot of the back/ports, serial number, or the unit powered on with sound.
Watermark 'AYOOLA IFEOLUWA' overlaid on photo, likely a reseller listing tag, not relevant to condition.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the unit powered off or in an undetermined state; no screen-on, sound, or key-press test is visible.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have electrical/display faults.
risks.proof: A video or photo of the unit powered on, showing the LCD lit and responsive, plus a brief audio clip of keys producing sound.

risks.risk: Keys may be unresponsive, sticky, or missing due to visible yellowing and wear.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of multiple keys being pressed showing normal key travel and sound.

risks.risk: Speaker may be damaged given heavy staining/dirt around the grille.
risks.proof: An audio/video clip demonstrating speaker output at various volumes.

risks.risk: No power adapter included, which is required to operate the unit.
risks.proof: A photo showing the original or compatible power adapter included in the sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as adapter not included, needing separate purchase

risks.risk: Physical damage (cracks, broken buttons, missing knobs) not visible from this single angle.
risks.proof: Additional photos from front, back, and underside of the unit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as condition unknown, assume cosmetic and functional wear

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on with screen lit and a few keys played for sound.
Photos of the back of the unit showing ports and any brand/model sticker or serial number.
Photo confirming inclusion of a power adapter.
Close-up photos of the full key bed and buttons from multiple angles to check for damage.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by its visible model marking as a PSR-550 keyboard, but the seller's 'working perfectly' claim is unverifiable from a single static photo with no power-on, sound, or adapter evidence, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
